news_cards.title: Bihar Mein Naye Steel Hub Ka Vikaas: 51600 Karod Rupey Ka Nivesh
bullets: Bihar sarkar ne desh ke pramukh udyogik samuhon ke saath MoU par hastakshar kiye hain
Is naye steel hub ke vikaas se Bihar mein 51600 karod rupey ka nivesh hoga
Yeh pariyojna Bihar ko steel utpaadan mein aage badhane mein madadgar sabit hogi

news_cards.title: Bihar Mein AI Aur Digital Takneek Se Vidhayakon Ka Kshamta Vardhan
bullets: Bihar sarkar ne vidhayakon aur vidhan parsadon ke liye AI aur digital takneek ka prashikshan aayojit kiya hai
Is prashikshan se vidhayakon ki kshamta mein vruddhi hogi aur ve adhik prabhavi dhang se kaam kar payenge
Yeh prashikshan Bihar mein swachh aur prabhavi shasan ki disha mein ek mahatvapoorn kadam hai

news_cards.title: Maa Mudeshwari Boddh Gaya SultanGanj Aur Mandar Ke Aitihasik Sthalon Ka Vikaas
bullets: Bihar sarkar ne Maa Mudeshwari, Boddh Gaya, SultanGanj aur Mandar ke aitihasik sthalon ka vikaas karne ka nirnay liya hai
In sthalon ka vikaas pariyatan ko badhava denge aur Bihar ki sanskriti ko sanrakshit karenge
Yeh pariyojna Bihar mein pariyatan ko badhava dene mein madadgar sabit hogi

news_cards.title: Nasariganj-Panapur Nishulk Steamer Ferry Seva Ka Shubharambh
bullets: Bihar sarkar ne Nasariganj-Panapur nishulk steamer ferry seva ka shubharambh kiya hai
Is seva se logon ko safar karne mein aasani hogi aur arthik gatividhiyon ko bhi badhava milega
Yeh pariyojna Bihar mein parivahan ko sudharne mein madadgar sabit hogi

news_cards.title: JP Ganga Path Ko Vishwashtareya Swaroop Milega
bullets: Bihar sarkar ne JP Ganga path ko vishwashtareya swaroop dene ka nirnay liya hai
Is pariyojna se Ganga path ka vikaas hoga aur logon ko safar karne mein aasani hogi
Yeh pariyojna Bihar mein parivahan ko sudharne mein madadgar sabit hogi

news_cards.title: Bihar Mein Naya Integrated Steel Pariyojna Ka Vikaas
bullets: Bihar sarkar ne naye integrated steel pariyojna ka vikaas karne ka nirnay liya hai
Is pariyojna se Bihar mein steel utpaadan mein vruddhi hogi aur arthik vikas ko badhava milega
Yeh pariyojna Bihar mein udyog ko badhava dene mein madadgar sabit hogi

news_cards.title: Bihar Sarkar Ne RERA Ki Karyapranali Ko Pardarshi Banane Ka Nirnay Liya
bullets: Bihar sarkar ne RERA ki karyapranali ko pardarshi banane ka nirnay liya hai
Is nirnay se ghar kharidaron ko suraksha milegi aur unke hiton ki raksha hogi
Yeh nirnay Bihar mein awas pariyojnaon ko sudharne mein madadgar sabit hogi

news_cards.title: Patna Metro Nirmaan Ke Dauran Nehru Path Par Sugam Evam Nirbadh Yatayat Sunishchit Karna
bullets: Bihar sarkar ne Patna metro nirmaan ke dauran Nehru path par sugam evam nirbadh yatayat sunishchit karne ka nirnay liya hai
Is nirnay se logon ko safar karne mein aasani hogi aur arthik gatividhiyon ko bhi badhava milega
